reasoning_narrative: The debate centered on the proposition that Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) will be achieved by the year 2047. Starting with a neutral probability
dissent_log:
While the overall consensus strongly supports the achievement of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) by 2047, a minority view suggests this timeline may be overly optimistic. This perspective is primarily represented by Dr. Alex Morgan [evid_6638a3a158ff] and Dr. Yuki Tanaka [evid_ba2e3cd24608], who presented evidence arguing against the proposition.

This dissenting view was not dismissed because the quality of their evidence was considered high, with Dr. Morgan's evidence scoring 0.80 and Dr. Tanaka's scoring 0.85 on the EVID-Q scale.
